title: OpenSearch security plugin (paraphrase)
text: OpenSearch is open-source software under the Apache 2.0 license and can be self-hosted on your own servers. Its security plugin supports several authentication backends, including internal users, LDAP, SAML and OpenID Connect, so single sign-on can be configured against an existing identity provider. OpenSearch runs on the Java virtual machine; operators must size heap memory and plan for cluster management, snapshots and upgrades.
